# Project rules

- Keep the project as a lightweight, dependency-free HTML/CSS/JavaScript app unless a change clearly requires otherwise.
- Preserve the existing space-quiz flow: answer selection, score updates, progress display, results, and restart.
- Keep user-facing text in Korean and use clear, accessible labels and button text.
- Prefer semantic HTML, keyboard-accessible controls, responsive layouts, and reduced-motion support.
- Make focused changes in `index.html`; avoid unrelated rewrites.
- Verify changes in a browser preview before considering the task complete.
